analysis: The supplied units are base_text excerpts of docs/reference/configuration.md (lines 950-1217 and 1217-1450). Both fall outside the changed ranges, which are lines 3 and 201 only. They cover the cluster runtime block, the parity-qualification description, coordinator-paired member approvals, the link setup/fix/removal flow, and the cluster console. The patch excerpt is truncated, so I cannot see the full change. It updates the date and rewrites the `backend.enabled_models` row. That row now describes a persisted operator filter that restricts coordinator `load_model`, `prefetch_model` and `desired_models` when Autopilot is off. This is a documentation change and does not alter code or controls. The documented behavior is a tighter operator-side restriction on coordinator-driven loads. It bears on A-004 and A-018 and on the TB-002 coordinator-to-provider contract. I found no weakening of the trust boundary, attestation, encryption or authorization. The row at line 201 is not visible in the supplied units, so I could not confirm its exact text. I did not examine the cited code, `ProviderLoop+ModelSelection.swift` (`operatorFilterAllows`), to confirm it matches the documentation. Next reviewers should check that the filter cannot be bypassed through Autopilot or alias-successor paths. They should also check that a hand-edited `enabled_models` takes effect only at restart, as documented. The documented public-traffic admission for cluster models (lines 983-1002) reflects an owner decision made before this PR. It is not changed here and is a pre-existing policy statement.
